question: In which year did Timur capture Delhi?
solution:
The answer is __**1398.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1398 A.D., the Timur or Tamerlane invaded India during the reign of Nasiruddin Mahmud, the last king of the Tughlaq dynasty.**
 
• Attacking the Delhi Sultanate ruled by Sultan Nasir-ud-Din Mahmud Shah Tughluq.
 
• He started his journey from Samarkand. After crossing the Sindh river, he entered Punjab.
 
• He crossed Indus and captured Multan, and just walked over to Delhi without much resistance.
 
• Tamerlane was a Turco-Mongol, who founded the Timurid Empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi Sultanate:**

 
 
• **The period between 1206 A.D. and 1526 A.D.** in the history of India is known as the **Delhi Sultanate period.**
